Used for every series unless you change a series in the reader (View settings there apply to that series only).
Works at Rock Robotics in Korea as an industrial drone specialist, mainly agricultural drones — working to make farming villages short of hands prosperous, livable places through drones and robots.

I wish for peace on the Korean Peninsula — that the war will stop, that weapons will become farm machines that drive out poverty, and that everyone who suffered through war can be happy with their families.
Made with deep respect for the Komga and Komelia projects. Thank you to their authors and contributors.

Open source: Komelia (Apache-2.0, parts of the reader logic), komga-client (MIT), Noto Sans (SIL OFL 1.1, banner), AndroidX / Jetpack Compose, Coil, OkHttp, Ktor (Apache-2.0). TV Reader for Komga is an unofficial app, not affiliated with Komga or Komelia.
